artifact_layout.gpu6_ouro: 10 unmodified Phase-2 run directories copied from the isolated GPU6 worktree
artifact_layout.gpu7_huginn: 13 unmodified Phase-2 run directories copied from the isolated GPU7 worktree
artifact_layout.m1_matrix.csv: selected warmed physical FIFO/Oracle one-token medians
artifact_layout.trace_inputs: unmodified Phase-1 Ouro Alpaca q0.2/q0.4 trace inputs

measurement_contract.prompt_source: deterministic synthetic text with heterogeneous lengths; traces supply exit depths only
measurement_contract.exit_source_for_comparison: trace-forced, with actual physical recurrent computation and survivor gather
measurement_contract.scheduling: FIFO versus perfect-depth Oracle at each token boundary; no refill inside intervals
measurement_contract.core_time: sum of synchronized CUDA-event recurrent passes, including their KV updates but excluding prelude/coda/compaction/exit-copy
measurement_contract.decode_wall_time: instrumented token-loop wall time; prefill and model load excluded
measurement_contract.reduction_pct: 100 * (FIFO - Oracle) / FIFO, computed from per-strategy medians
measurement_contract.peak_hbm: includes prefill; see each run summary

selection.m1: 12 cells: both models, two thresholds each, B8/B16/B32, N32, one token; 2 warmups per strategy then 3-5 repeats
selection.m2: four cells: Ouro q0.4 and Huginn threshold0.5, B16, N32, 16/32 tokens; one warmup per strategy then two repeats
excluded_from_matrices_but_preserved: initial Ouro q0.2 B16 two-repeat M1 with insufficient warmup (run 20260916T121941Z_4072140)
initial Huginn B16 synthetic-depth M1 before B1 shared-KV traces existed (run 20260916T121941Z_4072141)

scope_limits: No native full-depth quality or latency baseline
Oracle uses true forced depths rather than a practical predictor
M2 has only two warmed repeats per strategy
